items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: Or Preston. Well now I'll tell you what. [INTERVIEWER] Preston's over here, isn't it?

ctx.x: And the club in New York was the same thing? Yeah, it was the club.

Yeah, you take like, they'd meet up there, 125th Street there. Cab Calloway and all of them. I was living in New York then, and I was playing around then. So the last job I had, they wanted to book me out of the city to go to other places. I told them, I said no I can't go up there. I worked in the hospital too. You see I played at night. I worked in the hospital, a nurse, and then I played at night, see? Playing for my commission where I was schooling, you know? I told them I couldn't go, so I said well give me…
